system.name: AgentOccam
system.one_liner: A simple LLM web agent whose action and observation spaces are aligned with LLM training: fewer actions, cleaner observations, branch and prune planning.

content.variant_note: agent-environment loop with a central coloured band that turns the original action and observation spaces into aligned ones, drawn as paired grey and teal strips
content.argues: A plain LLM policy does better on web tasks when its actions and observations are made more compact and less redundant, instead of building a compound policy.
content.subject: Agent and web environment exchanging action A_t and observation O_t, with original versus aligned action chips and observation text in between.

lessons.what_to_learn: Put the method as a coloured band between agent and environment and show its two effects as paired Original (grey) and Aligned (teal) strips, so the reader sees what was shortened without reading prose.
lessons.suits: interface-design contributions (action and observation spaces) for agents that interact with an environment, where before and after versions can be drawn in the same grammar.

evidence: We reduce non-essential actions to minimize the agent's embodiment and trivial interaction needs
We introduce two planning actions (branch and prune), which enables the agent to self-organize navigation workflow with a planning tree
we enhance the web agent simply by aligning the web interaction action and observation space

summary: AgentOccam is a simple baseline for LLM-based web agents that improves the agent by aligning the action and observation spaces with what the LLM learned in training, instead of building compound LLM policies. Figure 1 is an agent-environment loop: a grey Agent region at the left with an illustrated robot (the LLM policy) and two speech bubbles, a dashed divider, and an Environment at the right with a stack of shop-page screenshots (Web Server). A central teal band named AgentOccam shrinks the original action chips into a short aligned set that adds red branch and prune chips, and turns the raw accessibility-tree text into a shorter aligned observation. Black arrows tagged action A_t and observation O_t carry the exchange.
summary_zh: AgentOccam 是 LLM 网页智能体基线，让动作与观察空间对齐 LLM 训练所学。图1画智能体与环境的循环：灰色智能体区有机器人和气泡，青绿色条带把原始动作与观察压缩，并新增 branch、prune 规划动作。
notes: Prior kinds kept. The Agent and Environment regions are counted as two titled panels; they could equally be read as containers of one drawing. The direction of the teal arrow between Aligned Actions and Original Actions is read from its arrowhead at the Original Actions strip; the thin teal line to Aligned Actions has no head. The roles of the speech bubbles (goal and reasoning of the policy) follow from their tails pointing to the robot. Chip colours other than red (the paper's two new planning actions) are not explained in the figure.
